subject: Escrow cadence: deposit ladder + consumption buffer reconciliation
messages:
From: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@bluebay.com>
To: jasmine_liu@redwood.ai
Cc: Finance Ops <payables@bluebay.com>
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Escrow cadence: deposit ladder + consumption buffer reconciliation

Hi Jasmine,

Thanks for the hosted inference walkthrough last week. Finance asked me to follow up on the invoicing / deposit cadence for our annual committed spend. A few specific asks so we can map this into our AP systems: 

- Can you confirm a recommended schedule for how Redwood would manage an annual deposit (one upfront payment) + monthly consumption draws? We want visibility into when a draw happens and the associated invoice so we can match to POs.
- We need a way to preserve a safety buffer (15% suggested) so production doesn't outage while monthly reconciliation completes — is that something Redwood supports from escrow / retained funds?
- VAT: our CFO wants to receive VAT-compliant invoices per country for any taxable services. What fields do you need from us (VAT ID, billing entity, address) and what evidence do you provide back?
- Finally, please include a sample ledger or CSV format that shows how token consumption maps to invoice lines (we need to ingest this into our AP).

Would appreciate a short runbook or sample schedule and any template attachments.

Thanks,
Marta Ruiz
Billing & Collections
BlueBay Analytics

Attachment: escrow_agreement_stub.pdf (PDF, 78 KB)

From: jasmine_liu@redwood.ai
To: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@bluebay.com>, Finance Ops <payables@bluebay.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 14:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Escrow cadence: deposit ladder + consumption buffer reconciliation

Hi Marta —

Thanks for the clear list. I put together a short proposal and attached two templates (escrow schedule + sample ledger CSV) to make integration easier. High level proposal below; I think we can meet all of your asks but want to confirm a few details in a quick 30-min sync.

Proposed approach (summary):
- Upfront: BlueBay wires an annual deposit to the escrow account on Day 0 (one invoice for the deposit).
- Buffer: We maintain a configurable safety buffer (we recommend 15%) that is earmarked in the ledger. Draws will never exhaust the buffer; once consumption + outstanding invoices drop below the threshold an automated refill alert triggers (manual or auto top-up per your preference).
- Monthly draws: At the end of each month we compute consumed units and generate an invoice that pulls funds from the escrow ledger up to the invoiced amount. Each monthly invoice includes a CSV ledger attachment that maps model / route / token buckets to invoice lines (sample attached).
- Real-time visibility: We expose a ledger CSV and a webhook / API endpoint for draw events so your AP system can ingest immediate draw notifications.

Questions for you:
1) Which BlueBay legal entity should Redwood invoice for tax purposes? (Name + VAT ID + billing address)
2) Do you want the monthly invoice to be issued the first business day of the month for prior-month consumption, or on-demand when a draw occurs?
3) Would your team prefer auto-refill (we pull an agreed top-up amount) or a manual approval flow?

Next steps:
- I attached: escrow_schedule_template.xlsx and sample_ledger_2025Q4.csv.
- Can we schedule 30 mins tomorrow to finalize the fields and PO integration? I've tentatively suggested 10:00am PT — happy to flex.

Cc'ing Kimberly (Revenue Ops) and Rishi (Billing) to weigh in on the invoice format and tax handling.

Thanks —
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachments: escrow_schedule_template.xlsx (Excel, 24 KB), sample_ledger_2025Q4.csv (CSV, 14 KB)

From: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
To: jasmine_liu@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: BlueBay escrow cadence proposal (notes + ops checklist)

Jasmine / Rishi — quick internal notes to lock the proposal before the sync with BlueBay. I'll paste the section into the shared proposal doc after you confirm.

Operational plan (recommended):
- Invoice cadence:
  * Day 0: Issue invoice for the full annual deposit (clears to escrow).
  * Monthly (first BIZ day): Issue invoice for prior-month consumption, deducting from escrow ledger. If escrow balance < (monthly estimated consumption + safety buffer) emit "Refill Required" event.
  * Ad-hoc draws: For large one-off usage spikes > 40% monthly estimate, allow an on-demand draw that triggers immediate notification to BlueBay payables with the supporting ledger CSV.
- Buffer handling: Maintain a 15% safety buffer by default. Implementation: escrow ledger tag "safety_buffer" that is excluded from draw calculations. Buffer refill policy: auto-topup up to X USD (configurable) or manual via PO.
- Ledger fields (required): invoice_id, draw_id, model_name, route, token_count, unit_price, net_amount, vat_amount, currency, billing_entity, consumption_window_start, consumption_window_end. (We need these exact headers in the sample CSV for BlueBay ingestion.)
- Tax/VAT: Billing flows we support:
  * If BlueBay provides local VAT IDs and billing entity per country, Redwood will issue VAT-compliant invoices per entity and include VAT line items (we collect VAT registration info up front).
  * If no VAT ID provided, we'll invoice the parent entity and include the tax-exempt note — finance should confirm tax treatment. Rishi, confirm whether we can split a single monthly invoice into country-specific line items or prefer separate invoices per entity.

Action items:
- Rishi: confirm whether we support separate invoices per country in the billing system (yes/no + any platform constraints).
- Jasmine: confirm BlueBay prefer auto-topup or manual approval.
- Jasmine: get PO number + billing entity details in advance of Day 0.

I'm attaching a short ops checklist that we can send to BlueBay after their confirmation.

-Kim

Attachment: ops_checklist_escrow_runbook.pdf (PDF, 32 KB)

From: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@bluebay.com>
To: jasmine_liu@redwood.ai
Cc: Finance Ops <payables@bluebay.com>, kimberly_park@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 13 Aug 2026 16:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Escrow cadence: deposit ladder + consumption buffer reconciliation

Thanks — this looks good and actionable. BlueBay confirms the following:

- We will proceed with the one-time annual deposit to escrow on Day 0.
- Buffer: we accept a 15% safety buffer and prefer auto-topup to $50k when refill is triggered.
- Invoice timing: please issue the monthly invoice on the first business day for prior-month consumption; the invoice should include the ledger CSV as an attachment so our AP can auto-match to the PO.
- Billing entity for VAT: BlueBay Analytics US (EIN: 12-3456789), VAT ID: N/A (US entity). For EU activity, we'll provide separate EU entity VAT IDs within 48 hours.
- PO number: BB-PO-2026-1129 — please reference this on the annual deposit invoice and all subsequent monthly invoices.

Can you share a DocuSign link for the escrow amendment and a sample invoice PDF for the Day 0 deposit so we can route to AP? I've CC'd our payables contact for direct ingestion questions.

Best,
Marta

Attachment: bluebay_po_BB-PO-2026-1129.pdf (PDF, 9 KB)
